lines: Haqeeqat hai ke mar kar bhi unhein hum yaad rakhenge
couplets.en: Even in death, I will remember them.

lines: Ye gulshan unki yaadon ka sada aabaad rakhenge
couplets.en: I will keep the garden of their memory in bloom.

lines: Mere saath unka waada hai, meri koi qabr na khode
couplets.en: They promised me that no one else would dig my grave.

lines: Mere is aakhiri ghar ki woh khud buniyaad rakhenge
couplets.en: They will lay the first stone of my last home themselves.

lines: Mujhko ye teri bewafai maar daalegi
couplets.en: Your faithlessness will be the death of me.

lines: Lagta hai mujhe ye judai maar daalegi
couplets.en: I fear this parting will be the death of me.

lines: Chal gaya naata mera ashkon se jod ke
couplets.en: You left me bound to my tears.

couplets.en: You did me wrong when you walked away.

couplets.en: You chose poorly.

lines: Sab kuchh luta ke hamein chhod jaana
couplets.en: After I gave everything, you walked away.

lines: Mohabbat ka ye sila achha nahin
couplets.en: That was a poor return for love.

lines: Aaya phir thandi ye hawaon ka zamana
couplets.en: The season of cold winds has come again.
